modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards

ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Connect with the customer to prepare the job card

pcs.pc_description: collect information about the vehicle and customer allocated by front desk or customer care executive w.r.t walk in or advance booking, as specified by OEM or dealership

review vehicle information such as validity of insurance, extended warranty, road side assistance, special bulletins and recalls issued by OEM, service/replacement, requirement based on vehicle service history
interact with the customer to understand the requirement or any specific concern other than routine/periodic maintenance/service
communicate with the customer and note down the environmental condition of the vehicle to address or reproduce any malfunction
communicate with the customer and note down the environmental condition of the vehicle to address or reproduce any malfunction
carry out visual inspection of the vehicle and create the job card/inspection sheet based on the vehicle condition and details given by the customer
hand over all personal belongings to the customer from the vehicle and collect necessary documents required for service
update customer contact details and complete the job card including list of all the service, repair and replacement requirements of the vehicle
verify availability of technical workforce/team, spare parts, tools and other consumables required
estimate cost of service/repairs including parts, consumables, labour and expected time of delivery using typical cost sheets recommended by OEM/organisation.
explain the required repairs and services along with their time and cost estimates to the customer and accordingly record job refusal or confirmation in the job card/repair order
finalise the list of all the service, repair and replacement requirements of the vehicle in consultation with the technicians and get customer's confirmation/acknowledgement to start the service

modules.module_title: Carry out activity for vehicle return/invoicing as per agreement

pcs.pc_description: confirm the service/repair progress status update of vehicle from floor team and inform the customer about any deviation from the communicated time or cost estimate
carry out final inspection of the vehicle and verify completion all the service, repair and replacement including vehicle washing and cleaning
close the job card, prepare a pre-invoice and verify all the service, repair and replacement are as per job card
confirm completion of service/repairs and delivery time to customer
explain the overall service and tasks performed on the vehicle to the customer with the help of itemised pre-invoice
assist customer to locate the vehicle and perform joint inspection, offer test ride to check vehicle performance post service/repair
explain to the customer about the next service schedule or pending repair requirement if any
record customer's feedback regarding the service provided to ensure that the customer is satisfied with the service experience
assist customer in making payment, getting gate pass and collect the vehicle

modules.module_title: Perform post service/repair activities and manage customer relationship

pcs.pc_description: call the customer to seek Post Service Feedback (PSF) as specified by OEM, note down the responses and update customer about follow-ups required, if any
update customers' PSF in specified format as per OEM
report customers’ issues/complaints immediately to concerned person/department and seek assistance form seniors to resolve the same
ensure least turnaround time for any customer query handling/redressal, especially issues related to warranty claims and other performance related issues
maximise customer satisfaction by ensuring pleasant and excellent customer experience as per OEM standards and guideline
maintain a healthy and professional relationship with customers, especially key accounts and influencers in the market
